purpose: Local model routing for phase execution. This is a local preference file, not a generated Zoo Code cache.
rules: Architect profile decides or corrects the plan before developer profile edits code.
Developer profile implements one accepted slice at a time.
Use installed same-family Qwen3 models before requesting new pulls, to avoid Continue or Zoo Code timeouts from missing tags.
Qwen3 8B long-context variants are the default Phase 9 architecture models on the Acer Predator Helios 300 profile.
Qwen2.5-Coder 7B remains the daily developer coding model because it is installed and stable locally.
DeepSeek R1 14B is an architecture fallback or escalation model only, not the daily default.
Keep context at 4096 or 8192 by default; do not use 65536 unless explicitly approved for a one-off architecture pass.
Generated Zoo Code cache files are not edited here.
